issues.quote: the supplied evidence lists fairness only as an example objective in Annexes B/C (B.9.3, C.2.5)
issues.explanation: The word «only» and the limited citation «(B.9.3, C.2.5)» are contradicted by evidence item S42001-130 (§B.5.4), which is in the same section's evidence list. S42001-130 prints fairness among «زمینه‌های تأثیرپذیری که «باید» به‌عنوان بخشی از ارزیابی در نظر گرفته شود» — a shall-level, non-exhaustive list of areas to address in impact assessments. Characterising all evidence as «example objective» misrepresents the SHALL modality used in §B.5.4, and omitting B.5.4 from the citation creates a misleading picture of what the supplied evidence actually shows.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the phrase with something like: «the supplied evidence shows fairness as a shall-level area to consider in impact assessments (§B.5.4) and as an example objective in Annexes B/C (B.9.3, C.2.5); it was not identified as a standalone Annex A control objective in the supplied evidence.» This preserves the accurate core correction (fairness ≠ Annex A control) while accurately reflecting the modality difference between §B.5.4 and §§B.9.3/C.2.5.
